tldr: Speaker 1 debriefed a first-round interview with candidate Ed (senior engineer): strong communicator with fast career progression, good AWS/Azure and OpenTofu exposure, and WMS domain knowledge.
Concerns: weak TypeScript/Node (sees it as front-end), little SRE/DevOps, and only about five years' experience going into a senior role. No hard no and no red flags.
Agreed to move Ed to a second round with a code review and systems design challenge, watching whether he is pragmatic or tries to control the room.
Salary: Ed asked for 75k. Harry's side wants to bank the TypeScript gap and could offer lower with room to grow; no figures were set. Feedback to Ruby should stay light.
Also discussed Jack: three overflow Shopify stock sync tickets in sprint 15 critical to Charlotte Tilbury, and a good catch-up with Jack on being too technical.
decisions: Progress Ed to a second round, with a code review and systems design challenge.
Do not give Ruby pejorative feedback about Ed's TypeScript maturity; bank it as a factor for any offer or salary discussion.
Decide on the day of the second round whether to bring the team in for the design or keep it between the interviewers with a team Q&A, depending on the teamwork seen.
Tentatively schedule Ed's second round for Thursday 26 November.
